content: प्रियङ्गुः .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a creeper (said to put forth blossoms at the touch of women); प्रियङ्गुश्यामाङ्गप्रकृतिरपि <ls>Māl. 3. 9</ls>. (For some of the conventions of poets about the blossoming of trees, see the quotation under अशोक.) .²2 Long pepper. .²3 A plant and its perfume (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>गव्हला</ns>); <ls>Mb. 13. 104. 87</ls>. .²4 A kind of millet (राजिका; <lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>राळा</ns>); दश ग्राम्याणि धान्यानि भवन्ति व्रीहियवास्तिलमाषा अणुप्रियङ्गवो गोधूमाश्च खल्वाश्च खलकुलाश्च <ls>Bṛ. Up. 6. 3. 13</ls>. .{@-गु@} {%n.%} .²1 Saffron. .²2 mustard seed.
